_about.what: Hand judgment of every frozen row (frozen.json): which real-world happening it is about.
_about.made: 2026-10-29, by reading every headline; applied under JP's standing delegation (2026-07-12) - the picture goes to JP for verdict
_about.rule: Same happening = the house rule in scripts/news/group_news.py SYSTEM: one specific happening keeps one label across its phases (announcement, release, contents, reactions, follow-ups) and across outlets; a different occasion (another speech, a meeting, another document, another year) is a different happening.
_about.classes: merge_encyclical: core = the 2026 AI encyclical Magnifica Humanitas; not = clearly a different happening; border = the house rule doesn't settle it (never asserted either way). split_sunday / cross_night: happenings (2+ rows), singles (a row that is its own happening), unsure (can't judge from the headline - never asserted).
